title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Join our frontend team to build responsive web applications using React and modern JavaScript. Great learning opportunity for students.

title: Python Backend Intern
description: Work on backend APIs using Python Flask and Django. You will learn database design, REST APIs, and server-side logic.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyze datasets, create visualizations, and present findings to stakeholders. Tools include Python, Pandas, and Tableau.

title: Mobile App Developer Intern
description: Build cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter and Dart. Work closely with designers and backend engineers.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Design user-friendly interfaces and prototypes using Figma. Collaborate with developers to bring designs to life.

title: Cloud DevOps Intern
description: Learn AWS, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Help automate deployments and manage cloud infrastructure.
